query: SELECT cm.title as module_name, COUNT(*) as total_lessons, MIN(CHAR_LENGTH(cl.content)) as min_chars, AVG(CHAR_LENGTH(cl.content)) as avg_chars, SUM(CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(cl.content) < 7000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as below_standard FROM course_lessons cl JOIN course_modules cm ON cl.module_id = cm.id GROUP BY cm.id, cm.title ORDER BY below_standard DESC, avg_chars ASC;
